[SWS_DM_01420]
SOVD
data-list
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04260, RS_Diag_04258
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall provide the SOVD methods
Retrieve
List of All Data-Lists Provided by the Entity
,
Creating a Data
List for Reading Multiple Data Values at Once from an Entity
,
Read Multiple Data Values at Once from an Entity Using a Data
List
and
Delete an Existing Data List
according ASAM SOVD[5].
⌋
